title: Unable to boot RPG Maker MV - DLL error

posts.author: EthanFox
posts.body:
EDIT: FIXED, but suggest locking and leaving this as I've posted the solution I found below.
Went away on vacation for just over a week, and upon coming back, I am unable to load MV via Steam.
When I run the app, I get an error box with this error:
When I click OK, the box reappears 4 more times (I have to dismiss it multiple times) and MV does not open
I have tried...
* A reboot
* Running a repair install on the MS VS C++ redistributibles (x86 and x64), each of which required reboots
* Ditto for the 2013 version
* Verify of RPG Maker MV's installer folder
* Checking my Avast Antivirus Quarantine (nothing there)
None of these have fixed the issue.
What's weird is that this was working fine until a few days ago. The
only
thing I can think of is that Windows 11 updated when I came home.
I can also see that a file with this name is present under the folders for MADO and SAKAN; should one be present under MV?
If anyone can fix this, please let me know. My project is completely stalled until I fix it.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
How about you copy the file into the folder contains rmmv exe?
However, it sounds like your system is damaged. Did you run a scan disk when you saw the error?

posts.author: SeaPhoenix
posts.body: Doing a search for the .dll file in the folder where MV is installed shows that it's present in three locations: Mado, Sakan, and ...\Steam\steamapps\common\RPG Maker MV\tutorial-win (... indicates the folder where Steam is installed, not sure if you're using Steam).

posts.author: EthanFox
posts.body:
